discussion_comments.comment_body: I would like to avoid using `ESLint.Plugin` directly in the exported type, relying on it only for the `satisfies` check. Using a getter as proposed requires this type assignment, though; it could not be inferred. `{}` satisfies the type for initial assignment (which is then replaced) and I don't see this negatively affecting users in a practical sense.
small nit: could return `Array<IdentifierId>` and merge at caller, or make it more obvious you're writing to `deps`

we should be able to remove this `isSetStateType` (as discussed)
this will keep the logic cleaner (we rely on *just* dataflow instead of a hybrid of data-flow and typing)
